decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent care product that gained its own webpage in 2024, it shows visible commitment and only limited reason for management to reverse course now.
Although it remained only briefly mentioned online, it fits the firm's established floor-maintenance system and management is likely to continue it rather than admit a small but avoidable retreat.
Its dedicated page in 2024 signals stronger public commitment, and as a direct extension of the oiled-wood offer it is likely to be retained.
This underlay complements the core flooring business and can still be justified as part of a full-system offer, so management is more likely to persist than withdraw.
It appears to have weaker public emphasis and could be easier to cut than the more visible launches, but its close fit with installation needs still favors retention.
An oak parquet floor sits very near the firm's strategic center, so even with modest website prominence management is unlikely to remove it after committing development and sales effort.
